title: Adapter Ligation with AMX
author: Josh Quick
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bdp5i5q6

steps.title: Prepare AMX ligation reaction
steps.instruction: Combine 30 µL end‑repaired amplicon pools, 10 µL Ligation Buffer (LNB), 5 µL Adapter Mix (AMX), and 5 µL Quick T4 DNA Ligase in a tube for a total volume of 50 µL. Expect ~80 % recovery after subsequent clean‑up steps.

steps.title: Incubate ligation mixture
steps.instruction: Incubate the 50 µL ligation reaction at room temperature for 10 minutes (00:10:00).

steps.title: Add SPRI beads and mix
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL (1:1) SPRI beads to the tube, vortex the bead stock thoroughly beforehand to obtain a homogeneous brown suspension, then mix gently by flicking or pipetting.

steps.title: Collect liquid by brief centrifugation
steps.instruction: Pulse‑centrifuge the tube briefly to bring all liquid to the bottom.

steps.title: Incubate bead mixture
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube at room temperature for 5 minutes (00:05:00).

steps.title: Magnetic separation of beads
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a magnetic rack and incubate for 2 minutes (00:02:00) or until beads are fully pelleted and the supernatant is clear.

steps.title: Remove supernatant carefully
steps.instruction: Carefully aspirate and discard the supernatant without disturbing the bead pellet.

steps.title: First SFB wash
steps.instruction: Wash the beads with SFB to remove excess adapter.

substeps.instruction: Add 250 µL SFB and resuspend beads completely by pipette mixing (do not use 70 % ethanol).
Pulse‑centrifuge to collect liquid at the tube bottom.

steps.title: Second SFB wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the SFB wash to further clean the beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 250 µL SFB and resuspend beads completely by pipette mixing.
Pulse‑centrifuge to collect liquid at the tube bottom.

steps.title: Final spin to remove residual SFB
steps.instruction: Pulse‑centrifuge once more and discard any residual SFB; do not allow the beads to air‑dry.

steps.title: Elute DNA with EB buffer
steps.instruction: Add 15 µL Elution Buffer (EB) and resuspend beads thoroughly by pipette mixing.

steps.title: Incubate elution
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube at room temperature for 2 minutes (00:02:00).

steps.title: Separate beads magnetically
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a magnetic rack to pellet the beads.

steps.title: Transfer purified library
steps.instruction: Transfer the clear supernatant containing the final library to a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
